README.md: Project overview, tech stack, and repo structure
index.html: Full methodology write-up: pipeline, modeling, evaluation, financial impact, path to production
workflow_settings.yaml: Dataform project configuration (default project/dataset/assertion dataset, core version)
config/config.py: Environment paths, GCS bucket, BigQuery project/dataset, MLflow URI, Optuna trial counts
config/enabled_apis.txt: GCP APIs enabled for this project, read by scripts/enable_apis.sh
config/lgbm_classifier_best_params.json: Optuna-tuned best hyperparameters for the LightGBM classifier base model
config/lgbm_ranker_best_params.json: Optuna-tuned best hyperparameters for the LightGBM ranker base model
config/xgboost_classifier_best_params.js: Optuna-tuned best hyperparameters for the XGBoost classifier base model
config/xgboost_ranker_best_params.json: Optuna-tuned best hyperparameters for the XGBoost ranker base model
config/optimal_ensemble_weights.json: Optuna-tuned RRF ensemble blend weights for every base-model pairing and the full 4-model ensemble
scripts/setup.sh: Installs requirements.txt into the configured Python environment
scripts/enable_apis.sh: Enables every GCP API listed in config/enabled_apis.txt
scripts/run_training_pipeline.sh: Runs all four base-model training scripts sequentially, then ensembling
src/base_models/train_lgbm_ranker.py: Trains/tunes the LightGBM ranker base model (NDCG@5 objective)
src/base_models/train_lgbm_classifier.py: Trains/tunes the LightGBM binary classifier base model (average-precision objective, class-imbalance aware)
src/base_models/train_xgboost_ranker.py: Trains/tunes the XGBoost ranker base model (rank:ndcg objective)
src/base_models/train_xgboost_classifier: Trains/tunes the XGBoost binary classifier base model
src/ensemble/ensemble.py: Optuna-tuned Rank Reciprocal Fusion (RRF) ensemble weight optimization across every base-model pairing and the full 4-model blend
src/utilities/utility_functions.py: Shared helpers: train/val/test split, feature selection, BigQuery data loading, RRF scoring, Recall/NDCG/Precision/F1@K metrics, GCS model upload, heuristic-baseline evaluation
definitions/sources_orders.sqlx: Raw historical transaction records containing user orders
definitions/sources_products.sqlx: Raw dimensional lookup mapping product IDs to their text descriptions
definitions/sources_order_products_prior: Order basket line-item dataset containing item reorder labels
definitions/sources_order_products_train: Second order basket line-item dataset containing item reorder labels
definitions/staging/stg_orders.sqlx: Cleansed order records, a reproducible 10% sample of users with time metrics
definitions/staging/stg_products.sqlx: Product dimension records with an organic flag derived from text lookup
definitions/staging/stg_order_products.s: Unified table combining prior and training-set items into full transactional baskets
definitions/silver/base_analytical_table: Base analytical table compiling cleaned orders, products, departments, and aisles for feature generation
definitions/silver/candidate_skeleton.sq: Skeleton of every product a user purchased prior to the label order -- the historical anchor-order join target that prevents data leakage
definitions/silver/prelim_user_order_fea: User order patterns: basket size, time intervals, order/reorder volumes, distinct product counts
definitions/silver/prelim_user_order_dow: Wide table of historical product purchases by day of week
definitions/silver/prelim_user_order_tod: Wide table of historical product purchases by time of day
definitions/gold/skeleton_features.sqlx: Joins preliminary features to the candidate skeleton, forward-filling behavioral history for products not in the anchor order
definitions/gold/final_ml_features_table: The final master modeling feature matrix used to train the predictive ensemble classifiers
Notebooks/EDA/preliminary_eda.ipynb: Initial exploratory data analysis on the raw Instacart dataset
Notebooks/EDA/feature_eda_screening.ipyn: Feature screening: correlation/multicollinearity checks and cumulative-gain importance pruning
Notebooks/base_models/train_lgbm_ranker_: Notebook: trains/tunes the LightGBM ranker base model
Notebooks/base_models/train_lgbm_classif: Notebook: trains/tunes the LightGBM classifier base model
Notebooks/base_models/train_xgboost_rank: Notebook: trains/tunes the XGBoost ranker base model
Notebooks/base_models/train_xgboost_clas: Notebook: trains/tunes the XGBoost classifier base model
Notebooks/evaluation/model_evaluation.ip: Computes final evaluation metrics (Recall/NDCG/Precision/F1@5) and SHAP feature importance per model/split, writes results back to BigQuery for the dashboard
Notebooks/evaluation/financial_impact.ip: Translates model performance into projected financial impact (profit lift by driver), writes results back to BigQuery for the dashboard
